entry.focal: The near white lantern_floor pair and the cable-station box on the right. The hero (40 m south lip) reads only as a thin brown kerb running away along the right edge of the water; it has no glow and no visible drop.
entry.next_visible: The far north/east lantern line and a lit-window box (the moon pavilion) on the horizon. That is a reasonable distant cue.

reveal.focal: Two large noisy white mist domes in the foreground water just in front of the north steps, then island_w (grey cube on a slab) dead centre. The lip and the cloud sea, the 'money shot', are hidden behind the island; the lip shows as a dark line with no glow.
reveal.next_visible: Not applicable (the far shore). The cable station and lanterns on the right.

concept.focal: Flat dark water filling the lower-left, an unexplained white flat slab in the lower-left corner, and the cable-station box with white posts on the right. Concept 11's composition (lantern and wet rocks lower-left, teal water running to a spilling edge, cloud sea and moon beyond) is not there: the edge does not spill and nothing lies beyond it.

strip.focal: The rim walk's lantern row on the left and the pool on the right in frames 0-5. Frames 6-7 (east deck heading south) are completely dark: no lanterns, no edge detail.
strip.next_visible: The moon pavilion box shows in frames 3-5. The east deck leads nowhere visible.

fixes.detail: The lip must read as an edge: (a) drop the terrain south of y 67 between x 96 and 136 by at least 3 m within 1 m of the lip, so from eye height the water meets void/cloud; this is a layout/terrain change. (b) Make the lip face emissive teal, or put a continuous light strip on it, so it is the brightest band in the pool.

The 13 uplights at exactly 3 m pitch render as small opaque white tiles under or on the water. Render them as light-only emitters (no visible geometry) or as one continuous emissive strip along the lip. The unexplained white rafts scattered over the water in reveal and strip-3/4/5 should also be identified (they are not among s_pool's placements) and removed if they are markers.

It sits on the north-portal sightline to the lip (blue line on the plan) and fills the centre of the reveal. Moving it to about (99, 88) clears the view to the lip and lets the island frame the left third. Also confirm what the two noisy white domes in front of pool_steps_n are (mist proxies?): at 2-3 m tall they block the reveal and should be lowered to under 0.6 m or moved off the sightline.

Only 4 toro survived, all on the north/north-west deck; 'avoid: nav' removed the west and east deck ones. Add explicit toro at (85.6, 70.5) (the concept-11 lower-left lantern at the SW entry), (139.5, 82) and (139.5, 72) on the east deck, and at both lip ends (95.5, 66.5) and (136.5, 66.5) to bracket the hero.

27 boulders at an even 1.4-2.6 m pitch make beads-on-a-string round the north and west rim. Use clusters of 3-5 with 5-10 m gaps, concentrated at the inflow_spout, both stair entries and the two lip ends. The pine_bonsai and steam_bench edge_band scatters produced 0 placements; fix them or replace them with fixed positions at the island bays.

top_change: Make the south lip a real infinity edge: drop the ground beyond it so water meets cloud at eye height, and give the lip the brightest teal glow in the space. Right now the hero is an invisible kerb with walkable ground behind it.
plausibility: Ground continues level and walkable south of the infinity lip (visible in entry/concept as a dark deck beside the water). An infinity edge needs a drop immediately past the lip.

The pool is 50 x 30 m of open water with two islands. The middle third is a barren flat sheet; concept 30/11 show an irregular lagoon with rock fingers and more islands. Consider a third rock island or a rock spit from the north deck around (115, 95).
The emissive white tiles floating on or under the water surface are not physically meaningful as drawn.
